categories.main_business_segments: Camelot Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its main product applications cover automotive electronics, communication electronics, industrial control and energy storage, consumer electronics, and medical devices, with a strong focus on automotive electronics, especially in new energy vehicles (NEVs). The company also operates PCB trading through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in high-density interconnection (HDI) PCBs, rigid-flex PCBs, metal-based PCBs, composite substrates, microwave high-frequency boards, high-speed boards, and embedded capacitor/resistor boards. It employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as CTC integrated electric chassis thick copper multilayer PCB processing, soft-hard combined board technology, high thermal conductivity FR4 materials for 800V ultra-fast charging PCBs, and 77G millimeter-wave radar high-frequency material mixed pressing. The production follows a make-to-order model with strict quality control and lean manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers, especially in the NEV sector, Tier 1 suppliers, EMS factories, and major communication equipment manufacturers. The company serves industries such as automotive electronics (including battery management systems, electric drive systems, and intelligent driving systems), 5G communication infrastructure, servers, industrial automation, and energy storage systems. Notable clients include top domestic power battery manufacturers and international brands like Mobis and Panasonic.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong (Qingyuan) and Hubei (Anlu). It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Shenzhen for trading and export activities. Domestic sales account for about 67.6% of revenue, while overseas markets, including Europe, Japan, South Korea, and North America, represent approximately 32.4%. The company is expanding its international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Camelot Electronics operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of PCBs, supplying critical components to downstream manufacturers such as automotive OEMs, communication equipment producers, and industrial device manufacturers. It also engages in trading activities through subsidiaries but does not operate upstream raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in automotive PCBs, especially for NEVs, focusing on battery systems, electric drive integration, intelligent chassis, and high-voltage architectures. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 77 million RMB spent in 2024, and holds nearly 150 patents including about 50 invention patents. Key R&D projects include advanced thick copper multilayer boards, soft-hard combined boards for chassis sensors, high thermal conductivity materials for charging infrastructure, and high-frequency PCB technologies for radar and 5G applications. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and AI-enabled information systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized PCB products based on customer orders. The company follows a make-to-order production model and sells directly to downstream manufacturers and through trading partners. Additional revenue streams include processing services and government subsidies. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Camelot Electronics ranks 42nd among China's top 100 PCB companies and 83rd globally, with a strong competitive position in the NEV PCB segment. It competes with industry leaders in China and internationally but has a smaller product range and production capacity compared to top-tier competitors. The company is expanding into the specialty PCB market through acquisitions to strengthen its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately 1.6 billion RMB, a 20.24% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about 80.2 million RMB, up 89.09%. Total assets reached over 3 billion RMB, growing 10.83% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth driven by expanding orders in automotive and communication sectors, with ongoing capacity expansion projects to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Camelot Electronics emphasizes high reliability and quality in automotive PCBs, especially for safety-critical NEV applications, branding its products as 'life boards.' The company leverages early entry and deep collaboration in the NEV sector to build strong customer relationships and technical expertise. Its differentiated capabilities include advanced multilayer and HDI PCB technologies, customized solutions for intelligent driving and energy storage systems, and a commitment to innovation and lean manufacturing to enhance product performance and cost efficiency.
